en_summary: tae kim (firstadopter) quotes Fed Chair Kevin Warsh on Oct. 28: AI sector financial conditions tightening. Iran War -> Energy prices -> inflation -> discounting of forward rate policy matters. Warsh skeptical that rate hikes won't affect AI as expected returns differ; interest rates affect almost everything, seen in tech complex since early September with discriminating investments and credit spreads. Quoted own post on financial conditions tightening, $110+ oil, need Iran war resolution to lower energy prices/inflation/rates or risk recession.
text:
Oct. 28: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh on AI sector financial conditions tightening. Iran War -> Energy prices -> inflation -> the discounting of forward rate policy matters.

"CHAIRMAN WARSH: Thank you, Claire. So, there was a narrative for quite a while, maybe even in this room over the course of the last several press conferences, well, they're going to raise rates, they're talking about raising rates, but it's not going to have any effect on AI, because the returns that investors are expecting are so different. I was skeptical of that view.

Interest rates get in the cracks, interest rates affect directly or indirectly, almost everything. And what have we seen? Since early September what we've seen inside of the technology complex, outside of the technology complex, whether you pronounce it AI or SI, Claire, is up to you, what have you seen?

Interest rates have had an effect. You've seen market participants that are discriminating between the kinds of investments they want to make. You've seen credit spreads for certain assets widen out, gap out. For others you've seen some tightening in financial conditions, but not significantly.

So on the thrust of your question of -- with respect to the new technology and this investment surge, do interest rates matter? I believe they do. And I don't believe that they're somehow divorced from the rest of the economy."

name: Shay Boloor
zh_summary: 標普剛剛將 $META 信用展望修訂為負面，而這個Wedbush模型準確顯示了原因。Meta的計算能力預計到2030年將幾乎四倍增至26GW，累計資本支出約1.2萬億美元，將年折舊推至1710億美元，而沒有像 $AMZN、$GOOGL 或 $MSFT 那樣的成熟雲業務來變現該能力。但我認為這正是機會變得超級有趣的地方，因為Muse已有超過25%的週活躍用戶在購物，而Meta的Business Agents每週處理超過3000萬次客戶對話，為Meta創造機會來捕獲其AI代理促進的交易份額。
en_summary: S&P just revised $META credit outlook to negative and this Wedbush model shows exactly why. Meta’s compute capacity is projected to nearly quadruple to 26GW by 2030 on ~$1.2T in cumulative capex pushing annual depreciation to $171B without an established $AMZN, $GOOGL or $MSFT style cloud business to monetize that capacity. But I also think that’s where opportunity gets super interesting because Muse has over 25% of its weekly active users already shopping while Meta’s Business Agents handle over 30M customer conversations a week creating an opportunity for Meta to capture a share of transactions its AI agents facilitate.
